## Bulk Certificate Generator

Receives a list of names/emails via webhook →
Code generates styled HTML certificates per person →
Converts to PDF → saves to Drive → emails each recipient.

**Setup:**
1. Configure HTML-to-PDF API key
2. Set Google Drive folder
3. Set Gmail credentials
4. POST { recipients: [{name, email}], courseName, certificateType, issueDate }
